how: A finding hits a defect when it names the same file and its lines touch the defect's lines (1 line of slack). One finding can hit one defect.

1-csv-export.what: Live keys committed. The PR text says they are test fixtures: they still sign real exports (AC-10.1).
Client imports the server signing key, so it ships to the browser (AC-10.1).
escapeCSV lets =, +, - and @ through: formula injection in Excel (AC-5.6).
Two queries per post in a loop: 500 posts, 1001 round trips (AC-10.4).

2-view-tracking.what: visitorKey and referrer come from the request body: anyone skips the 24 h dedup (AC-6.3).
A repeat view answers 400. It is the normal case and should be 200 (AC-6.5).
The whole Authorization header goes to the log (AC-10.2).
Only admin views are internal. Authors re-reading their post inflate the count (AC-6.6).

3-dashboard.what: Comment text from anonymous visitors is rendered as HTML: stored XSS in the admin page (AC-4.3).
setInterval with no cleanup: every remount adds another poller, and polling is out of scope (AC-10.5).
category is sent but missing from dependencies: KPI cards keep the old category (AC-5.3).

decoys.what: POST /view has no auth on purpose: anonymous readers must be counted (AC-6.2). Flagging it is a false alarm.
